$comment: Replay evals for the workflow runtime: the code that turns model output into run decisions. Each case holds a model-produced text (phase output, CLI failure, learning file) in the shapes agents and CLIs actually return, plus the properties the runtime's decision must have. Graded deterministically by evals/replay.test.js against sdlc-suite/workflows; no model is called. Bump `version` (and the file name) when a case's expectation changes meaning; add cases freely.

cases.note: The common case: a schema-validated object whose notes field carries a multiline BLOCKED block. JSON.stringify would have escaped the newlines and lost it.
